title: The Regulatory Gateway: Purpose and Standards
summary: Why authorisation is a critical gatekeeping function, the threshold conditions applicants must meet, and how authorities balance market access and innovation against risk.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Why authorisation is a critical gatekeeping function, the threshold conditions applicants must meet, and how authorities balance market access and innovation against risk.
Learning Objectives: Explain the purpose and standard of assessment at the gateway
Describe the threshold conditions and how they apply proportionately
Balance market access and competition against risk to customers and markets
Syllabus: The gateway as the first and cheapest line of supervisory defence
Threshold conditions: legal status, resources, suitability and effective supervision
Proportionality across firm types, sizes and activities
International standards on licensing and authorisation
Intended Audience: Authorisation, licensing and registration staff assessing new applications and changes to existing firms
Fitness and propriety and governance specialists assessing controllers, directors and senior managers
Supervisors and financial crime specialists who contribute to authorisation decisions or take over newly authorised firms
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of authorisation, supervision or financial crime work is helpful. No legal or accounting qualification is required.
Core Reading: Basel Committee, Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision (2024)
IOSCO, Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulation (2017)
IAIS, Insurance Core Principles and Common Framework for the Supervision of Internationally Active Insurance Groups (ComFrame)
FATF, International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation: The FATF Recommendations (as updated)
